title: A Protocol for the Signal
author: Ines Voss
blurb: Felix Thornbury, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
